[[Longtooth's Shield]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Ehyal Longtooth]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Lahtenda Bog]].

==Stats==
*[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 12 (Requires 7 [[Strength]])
*[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Sharktooth Shield]] [[dye]]d silver.

**[[Asuran Shield]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
